correctness.rationale: An endpoint-fixing increasing homeomorphism preserves min, max and Gödel implication. On a finite world set it also commutes with the minima and maxima defining the two modalities. Structural induction therefore proves exact semantic conjugacy for every formula, and the inverse homeomorphism gives the bijection of valuations required for equality of frame-validity logics. Canonicalization and the ordered-Bell count then follow by finite weak-order combinatorics. A bundled exhaustive checker corroborates the first orbit counts and small-model semantic conjugacy.
